description: This source file defines the 'Filter' class in the Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog namespace. The class manages CRUD operations for filter entities, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving filters and their descriptions. It interacts with the database and cache to perform these operations.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: The Filter class provides methods to perform CRUD operations and manage descriptions for product filters in the Opencart admin catalog module.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Inserts a new filter into the database, adds descriptions for each language, and clears the filter cache.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Updates an existing filter and its descriptions, then clears the filter cache.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes a filter and its descriptions from the database, then clears the cache.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific filter, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filters, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Returns the total count of filters in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a filter in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific filter.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for filters associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific filter across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all filter descriptions in a specific language.
